name: Elite Robots MC500-12 (M-Bot series)
summary: An omnidirectional mobile manipulator from Elite Robots' M-Bot series: a Mecanum-wheel AMR with 300 kg platform payload carrying a 12 kg collaborative arm (1304 mm working radius) with 2.5D vision for ±0.2 mm positioning at the workstation.

germany.statusNote: Elite Robots runs its EMEA Operations Center in Geisenfeld (Bavaria) and lists authorised partners in Germany; the MC500-12 page has a "Get quote" form. No public price.

sellers.name: Elite Robots EMEA Operations Center
sellers.note: Address on the maker's page: "EMEA Operations Center Geisenfeld BY, Germany Münchener Str. 53 85290"; quotes through the product page form or a local partner.
